## Problem and resulting behaviour

Explain the concrete problem and what a student will experience after this change.

## Evidence and validation

State the checks actually run. For changes to citation rules or university
requirements, cite primary guidance with its date/edition and exact section.
For layout changes, include a small non-confidential PDF excerpt or screenshot.

## Scope and limitations

Identify any affected entrypoints, compatibility limits or unverified claims.
Confirm that the contribution contains no private research or unlicensed assets.
